title: Activity log
subtitle: Data Pack events, in-app events and every status change by the engine; append-only

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search actor, contract, milestone or event ID

actions.SIGNATURE_FINAL: Signed the contract, step {{step}}/{{total}}; CONTRACT_SIGNED recorded, contract effective
actions.DIGITIZATION_CONFIRMED_one: Locked the digitised terms, {{count}} milestone created
actions.DIGITIZATION_CONFIRMED_other: Locked the digitised terms, {{count}} milestones created
actions.EXCEPTION_APPROVED: Second controller approved voiding {{id}}; the engine re-evaluated
actions.PAYMENT: Simulated payment of {{amount}} million VND (idempotency key)

appendOnly: Append-only log: entries cannot be edited or deleted.

exceptions.title: BR-19 exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Milestones held by an unauthorised event or a data anomaly
exceptions.intro: The controllers' queue (spec 9.5). One proposes to void an unauthorised event, a second approves (SoD-2). Nobody forces a decision or an amount; the engine re-evaluates after each decision.
exceptions.searchPlaceholder: Search contract, milestone, buyer or event ID

integrity.title: Integrity check
integrity.subtitle: Whether the log, the evidence or the decisions were changed outside the application
integrity.checkedAt: Checked at {{time}}. Read-only: nothing is written.

chain.title: Audit log chain
chain.subtitle: Each entry carries the SHA-256 hash of the previous one
chain.head: Chain head

problems.LINK_BROKEN: Link to the previous entry broken

anchor.label: Saved chain head
anchor.placeholder: Paste the saved head, as number:hash
anchor.hint: Copy the chain head somewhere else (minutes, email, submission). Paste it here later: if the whole log was rewritten or truncated, it will not match.
anchor.MISMATCH: Does not match: the log was rewritten
anchor.NOT_FOUND: Entry not found: the log was truncated

evidence.title: Evidence recorded in the app
evidence.subtitle: Each event is sealed with a hash in its audit entry when it is recorded

decisions.title: Decision reconciliation
decisions.subtitle: Runs the engine again on the current data and compares every stored decision

integrity.note: The check finds entries edited, deleted or inserted when the data is touched outside the application. It does not replace backups or access control on the data store; someone able to rewrite the whole log is caught only against a chain head saved elsewhere.

errors.INVALID_ANCHOR: The saved head must be number:hash (64 hex characters).
errors.UNKNOWN: The check failed. Try again later.

dataPack.title: Organiser's original data
dataPack.subtitle: Data Pack rows against the hash sealed at import
dataPack.sealedAt: Sealed when the data was imported, {{time}}.
dataPack.none: This data was imported before sealing existed, so it cannot be compared.

auditDetail.noChanges: No data changed, or this older entry predates detailed change capture.

lite.exceptionsNote: One person proposes, a second person approves.
